description: 황금 용 아우라를 두른 동양 검사 — 사용자 디자인 참조 기반 SSS 리미티드 원화

source_reference.preservation: Byte-for-byte copy of user attachment; never overwritten.

style_references.role: Male facial rendering style only, not identity

versions.change: 후속 사용자 '머릿결좀'에 따라 띠·철사처럼 갈라진 긴 머리카락을 부드러운 연속 모발 흐름과 자연스러운 볼륨으로 수정.

generation.postprocessing: No crop, resize, recompression or pixel editing; generated PNGs copied unchanged.

observations: Reference-derived standing composition, open-palm pose, diagonal straight sword, asymmetrical ivory/black robe and gold armor retained.
Golden wingless Eastern dragon head, scaled coils, horns, whiskers and luminous front/back aura loops remain clearly visible.
V2 replaces separated sharp hair strips with a more connected flowing dark hair mass and finer subdued strands.
Face, costume, sword, dragon and aura composition visually compared after hair edit; design retained, not claimed pixel-identical.
Native exact 2:3 1024x1536 RGB PNG verified; no text, rank letters, watermark or card frame embedded.
visual_review.thumbnail_and_frame_review: Not performed; this deliverable is an unframed illustration draft, not an approved card.

note: 기존 승인 원화·앵커·프레임·게임 코드 수정 없음. 현재 요청은 원화 시안 및 머릿결 보정이며 최종 시각 승인이나 운영 연결로 확대하지 않음.
